metric_definitions.interface_distogram_nll: mean negative log probability of the observed Nesso distance bin for resolved protein-token/ligand-atom pairs at true distance <=15 A
metric_definitions.token_contacts: C-beta (C-alpha for glycine) to ligand-heavy-atom distance <=6 A
metric_definitions.physical_pocket: protein residue with any resolved protein heavy atom <=6 A from ligand
metric_definitions.ligand_symmetry: minimum NLL over exact graph-isomorphic ligand atom mappings

ligand_mapping.selection_rule: minimum interface distogram NLL; ties lexicographic
